## Checklist

- [ ] The title is a Conventional Commit with a scope, e.g. `fix(stylelint): …`; it becomes the commit message on `main`
- [ ] Tests cover the change, or it needs none
- [ ] A changeset is added (`pnpm changeset`) if a published package changes
- [ ] Docs are updated if behavior changes
